مُجَنَّبٌ ; and its fem., with ة: see جَنِيبٌ. ―
-b2- Also, the former, (TA,) or ↓ جَانِبٌ , (K, [but this is said in the TA to be a mistake,]) A horse wide in the space between the two kind legs, (K, TA,) without what is termed فَجَجٌ [which is an awkward kind of straddling, with the hocks wide apart]: it is a quality approved. (TA. [See also 2; and see مُحَنَّبٌ.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
